title: Web Hosting Plans Price Schedule: Term Rates, Setup Fee and Rounding
content:
**Web Hosting Plans — published price schedule (USD).** Every Web Hosting Plans tier is offered on a 1, 12, 24 or 36-month billing term; only those terms can be ordered. All rates in the first seven columns are prices **per month**.

| Tier | 1-month price (no commitment) | Introductory 12-month | Introductory 24-month | Introductory 36-month | Regular 12-month | Regular 24-month | Regular 36-month | One-time setup fee, 1-month plans |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Starter | 12.99 | 3.49 | 2.99 | 2.69 | 9.99 | 8.99 | 7.99 | 9.99 |
| Harborline Plus | 17.99 | 5.49 | 4.99 | 4.49 | 14.99 | 13.49 | 11.99 | 9.99 |
| Harborline Pro | 25.99 | 8.99 | 7.99 | 6.99 | 21.99 | 19.99 | 17.99 | 9.99 |
| Harborline Business | 38.99 | 13.99 | 12.49 | 11.49 | 32.99 | 29.99 | 26.99 | 0.00 |
| Harborline Cloud 4 | 59.99 | 24.99 | 22.99 | 19.99 | 49.99 | 44.99 | 39.99 | 0.00 |
| Harborline Cloud 8 | 104.99 | 44.99 | 39.99 | 34.99 | 89.99 | 79.99 | 69.99 | 0.00 |

**What each column means**

- *1-month price (no commitment)* — the price per month on the 1-month term; the 1-month term has no introductory price.
- *Introductory 12, 24 and 36-month* — the introductory price per month for a first term of that length. On every tier the introductory price applies only to the first term of a new plan.
- *Regular 12, 24 and 36-month* — the regular price per month for a term of that length, used for renewals and for non-introductory purchases.
- *Setup fee* — a one-time fee on a plan bought on the 1-month term.

**Offered terms (all tiers):** 1, 12, 24 and 36 months.

**Rounding (all tiers):** every computed Web Hosting Plans amount is rounded half up to the cent.

**Rounding illustration (hypothetical amounts).** A computed amount of USD 147.605 is rounded half up to USD 147.61; a computed amount of USD 147.6049 is rounded to USD 147.60.
